notes: 42725000_B: hat/double-joggle strip (~10 mm wide, ear with hole on web). Tab5 -> left riser -> web -> right riser -> tab4: 4 x ~90 deg formed bends, each runs the full strip width. Risers are unsegmented, so each riser side is a plane_from_points seeded on the OUTER skin of that bend (normals verified outward).

bends.note: B1 left joggle upper: tab5 top skin / left riser +u face (outer)
B2 left joggle lower: web underside (1) / left riser -u face (outer)
B3 right joggle lower: web underside (1) / right riser +u face (outer)
B4 right joggle upper: tab4 top skin / right riser -u face (outer)
